title: Chord
description: Turns every incoming note into a chord of the chosen type (for example major) and inversion. It takes notes between a clip and an instrument and gives notes back.

parameters.name: enabled
parameters.doc: Off passes the notes through untouched (bypass).

parameters.name: type
parameters.doc: The chord built on every note.

parameters.name: inversion
parameters.doc: How many of the lowest notes move up an octave.
